instructor: Prof. Bryson is an old school instructor—more methodical, thorough, and exacting than some of the newer faculty members. This is not, however, necessarily a weakness—I believe that being taught by a variety of teachers with diverse teaching techniques is one of the greatest assets of this department. So I would confidently say that Prof. Bryson’s more classical method of teaching and class format was very useful for me, especially in that I feel more prepared for continuing on in academia, and in intellectually and operationally demanding spaces. He clearly also has a firm grasp on the topics that he brings up in class (hilariously, it is not rare that he personally has met the authors we read) and his confidence is evident from the way he can just stride into class, start talking, and never have to consult his notes. I genuinely enjoyed his classes thus far, and can tell that they really helped me improve my academic method greatly.
course: The format of the course is pretty straightforward, which I appreciate, and the class discussions we held in accordance with the assigned texts were very useful in getting to think outside the box. And even though I personally can not imagine cutting out any of the readings we did, as they were all very useful, I still felt fairly overwhelmed with them. Perhaps the slightest reduction in the amount of pages we were to read each week could be profitable in increasing meaningful in-class engagement with the text, as I felt that us students failed to read through the whole text quite often. As for me, I unfortunately had to skim over some texts, as they were on the longer side, and I ended up not being able to finish them on time. This could very easily be my own fault though! Other than the amount of texts assigned sometimes feeling rather daunting, I can’t think of a weakness to the course. I really found the workload of the course—sit-in midterm, sit-in final, take-home term paper, and frequent quizzes—to hit that sweet spot of intensive-but-not-brutal, and reaaaallllly appreciated that he gave us study guides. The study guides made it really easier for me to study on a more tightly-focused scale; made me relax from worrying about the content of the exam and just focus on studying, and required a lot of intense writing sessions to work my way through. Overall, very pleased.
